name: Anytype
tagline: Anytype is a local-first knowledge management and productivity tool that stores data encrypted on your device rather than in the cloud. It combines notes, tasks, databases, and wikis in a flexible block editor with AI features including AI writing assistance and semantic search. Designed as a privacy-respecting alternative to Notion.
